title: Decomposing time-varying data into simple pieces: structured decompositions of narratives
summary: Graphs that change over time arise throughout applications, but there is no single standard way to decompose them into smaller pieces. In this paper, we propose a systematic categorical method for doing so. The main idea is to combine structured decompositions, which generalize graph decompositions, such as tree-decompositions, with persistent narratives, which model time-varying data as diagrams.
